summary: The diff implements all four requirements (REQ-17, REQ-18, REQ-19, REQ-20) by adding the BlueFire logo to the header, hero section, and footer at medium sizes alongside the company name text. The logo is consistently referenced from the static asset path (though stored as /assets/file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png rather than /assets/generated/). All acceptance criteria appear to be met based on the evidence in the code.

hallucinated_features.description: Interactive navigation buttons with smooth scroll behavior in the Header component
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly states as a non-goal: 'Implementing logo click interactions or navigation behavior'. However, the Header component includes onClick handlers with scrollToSection functionality for 'Servicios', 'Programa Piloto', and 'Contacto' navigation buttons.

hallucinated_features.description: Logo stored in /assets/ directory instead of /assets/generated/ subdirectory
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-20 specifies the logo must be 'saved as a static asset in frontend/public/assets/generated directory', but the implementation references '/assets/file_00000000e32471fd987536c27237c5ae.png' without the '/generated' subdirectory path across all components.
